name: Practice Run
description: Practice mode with a memory. A purple button in the pause menu restarts the level in practice mode and counts your deaths - a run finished without dying is saved as a normal completion. Also adds 16 performance options for slower PCs, with an automatic mode and a one-click preset.

perf-auto-fps.name: Auto performance
perf-auto-fps.description: Watches your fps and tunes the rest by itself

perf-hide-particles.name: No particles
perf-hide-particles.description: Removes sparks, dust, fire and glitter

perf-half-bursts.name: Half-size bursts
perf-half-bursts.description: Effects spawn half as many particles

perf-effect-cap.name: Fewer effects
perf-effect-cap.description: Halves the game's limit on live effects

perf-freeze-offscreen.name: Freeze off-screen
perf-freeze-offscreen.description: Effects off screen stop being updated

perf-hide-trail.name: No player trail
perf-hide-trail.description: Removes the streak behind ship and wave

perf-no-object-glow.name: No object glow
perf-no-object-glow.description: Removes the glow around glowing objects

perf-hide-glow.name: No player glow
perf-hide-glow.description: Removes the glow around both player icons

perf-no-shake.name: No screen shake
perf-no-shake.description: Removes the pause and death screen shake

perf-hide-ground.name: Hide ground
perf-hide-ground.description: Hides the ground and the middle-ground

perf-no-death-effect.name: No death effect
perf-no-death-effect.description: Hides the explosion when you die

perf-hide-portals.name: Hide portals
perf-hide-portals.description: Portals still work but become invisible

show-pause-button.name: Show pause menu button
show-pause-button.description: Shows the practice and performance buttons in the pause menu

show-run-label.name: Show run label
show-run-label.description: Shows the death counter while a run is active

enable-by-default.name: Enable by default
enable-by-default.description: Starts a tracked run on every level you enter
